verdict.rationale: Zapier ships AI features (Copilot, agents, AI troubleshooting, MCP), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of a setting or policy that keeps customer data out of AI model training. SOC 2 certification and governed MCP access are adjacent security controls, not a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
